bundle.longDescription: Prism is an open-source, bit-perfect local music player for Windows and Linux. It pairs a Rust audio engine (WASAPI Exclusive, ASIO, PipeWire, ALSA, DSD over PCM, gapless playback, parametric EQ, EBU R128 loudness normalisation) with a fluid, keyboard-first interface designed for libraries with hundreds of thousands of tracks.
